page: Microsoft Azure D48pls_v6 is a general-purpose, compute-dense virtual machine built on Microsoft Hyper-V and powered by an arm64 architecture. The server is provisioned with 48 dedicated physical cores operating at 3.4 GHz using ARM Neoverse-N2 processors, with a single thread per core and no simultaneous multithreading. It includes 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 128 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity is configured at 96.0 GB, establishing a 2.0 GB per vCPU ratio. The instance does not include local storage disks or integrated GPUs, requiring attached network or premium storage volumes for persistent filesystem operations.

Benchmark results highlight significant multi-threaded computational and memory throughput. The instance achieves top-tier results in uncached large-block memory read bandwidth (463.86 GB/sec) and write bandwidth (199.92 GB/sec), supported by a Geekbench multi-core score of 21,950.0 and PassMark database operations rating in the top ten percent. Multi-threaded decompression and software compilation via Clang demonstrate strong performance across all 48 dedicated cores. However, single-core execution metrics, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores, register within the middle tier, and large language model inference for 70B parameter models shows lower processing rates.

Because the server combines 48 dedicated ARM cores with a compact 2 GB per core memory footprint and omits bundled local storage, it offers a resource-dense configuration for compute workloads that do not demand extensive RAM pools. This resource balance provides cost-efficient processing power for horizontally scaled applications, CI/CD build farms, static web hosting, and networked database operations.
description: Microsoft Azure D48pls_v6 is an arm64 general-purpose server powered by a 48-core ARM Neoverse-N2 processor clocked at 3.4 GHz. Featuring dedicated physical cores without simultaneous multithreading, the system includes 128 MB of L3 cache alongside 96.0 GB of system memory, providing 2.0 GB per core. The server lacks bundled local storage and GPU hardware, depending entirely on remote storage infrastructure. Performance benchmarks show exceptional multi-core scalability and top-tier memory bandwidth, achieving 463.86 GB/sec in uncached read tests and strong metrics in multi-threaded software compilation and database operations. While single-thread performance and large-parameter model inference are moderate, the high core density and low memory overhead make the D48pls_v6 an efficient deployment target for multi-threaded build pipelines, web serving clusters, and containerized microservices.
